name: Snake Scale Cloak
body:
Aura: faint abjuration; CL 9th; Slot: back; Price: 8,000 gp (+1), 16,000 gp (+2), 24,000 gp (+3), 30,000 gp (+4); Weight: 2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

These black capes are made of thousands of fine, supple snake scales. The cloak offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +4 resistance bonus on saving throws versus poison and a deflection bonus to AC. Last, it gives a +2 competence bonus on Climb and Stealth checks.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells delay poison, darkness, shield of faith, spider climb; Special creator’s caster level must be at least three times the cloak’s bonus; Cost: 4,000 gp (+1), 8,000 gp (+2), 12,000 gp (+3), 15,000 gp (+4)
